soulpouch.tooltip.help1: Wear in the Soul Pouch slot: soul items you walk over go in here.
soulpouch.tooltip.help2: Right-click it in a slot: empty hand takes a stack, soul items store them.
soulpouch.tooltip.help3: In hand: use to take a stack, sneak-use to store all from your inventory.
soulpouch.tooltip.death: Kept on death, but %s%% of its contents are lost.
soulpouch.msg.not_worn: You aren't wearing a Soul Pouch.
soulpouch.msg.death_lost: Your Soul Pouch lost %s soul items.
soulpouch.msg.death_dropped: %s soul items spilled from your Soul Pouch.
soulpouch.msg.waystone_need: This journey needs %s %s in your Soul Pouch.
